title: Fixture provenance record
description: Sidecar record required for every synthetic fixture under fixtures/**. One `<name>.provenance.json` accompanies each `<name>.json` fixture and documents where the fixture's shape came from, how it was sanitized, and a content hash so drift is detectable in review.

fixture.description: Filename of the fixture this record describes, relative to this file's directory.

sourceContract.description: What protocol/contract the fixture's shape is modeled on: a public spec URL, a named third-party CLI's documented hook format, or "synthetic" when the shape is invented for this repository.

provider.description: Provider id the fixture represents (lowercase, hyphenated), or "synthetic" for the invented reference protocol.

providerVersionObserved.description: Version of the third-party tool the contract was observed against, if any. Omitted for purely synthetic fixtures.

capturedDate.description: ISO 8601 date the fixture was authored or last reviewed.

author.description: Person or agent role that authored the fixture.

sanitization.description: Explicit statement of what was removed or invented to make this fixture safe: no real transcript text, no real credentials, no real filesystem paths or hostnames.

licenseBasis.description: Why this repository may include the fixture: original synthetic authorship, or a specific permissive license covering a reproduced protocol shape.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the sibling fixture file, recomputed and checked by scripts/fixtures/validate-fixtures.mjs.

notes.description: Optional free-text context, e.g. which parity dimension the fixture exists to exercise.
